subject: Sales
title: [PLACEHOLDER] Sales Basic: monthly assessment
note: Sample questions for testing. Replace them with questions approved by the Sales head before go-live.

questions.text: What is a sales pipeline?
options: A list of products in stock
A visual view of open deals by the stage each has reached
A report of last year's revenue
correct: A visual view of open deals by the stage each has reached

questions.text: Which stage normally comes first in a B2B sales process?
correct: Prospecting

questions.text: In the BANT qualification framework, what does the A stand for?
correct: Authority

questions.text: Which of these are part of BANT qualification? Select all that apply.
correct: Budget
Need
Timeline

questions.text: A lead and a qualified opportunity are the same thing.
correct: False

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a discovery call?
options: To understand the customer's needs, situation, and decision process
To close the deal on the first call
correct: To understand the customer's needs, situation, and decision process

questions.text: Which type of question best encourages a customer to explain their situation?
options: An open question such as 'How do you handle this today?'
A question about your own product's features
A leading question that suggests the answer
correct: An open question such as 'How do you handle this today?'

questions.text: Every customer interaction should be recorded in the CRM so the account history is not lost.
correct: True

questions.text: What does 'win rate' measure?
options: The share of closed opportunities that were won
The number of calls made per day
correct: The share of closed opportunities that were won

questions.text: Which are good practices when handling an objection? Select all that apply.
options: Ask a question to understand the concern
Argue that the customer is wrong
Answer with evidence relevant to their need
correct: Listen fully before replying
Ask a question to understand the concern
Answer with evidence relevant to their need

questions.text: In a B2B deal, who is the 'economic buyer'?
options: The person who will use the product daily
The person with final authority to approve the spend
The procurement clerk who raises the PO
correct: The person with final authority to approve the spend

questions.text: What is a 'value proposition'?
options: A clear statement of the outcome the customer gets and why it matters to them
correct: A clear statement of the outcome the customer gets and why it matters to them

questions.text: Discounting early in a negotiation usually strengthens your position.
correct: False

questions.text: What does BATNA mean in negotiation?
options: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement
correct: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement

questions.text: Which signal most strongly suggests a deal is ready to close?
options: The customer asks about delivery dates and implementation
The customer asks for another product brochure
The customer has no budget this year
correct: The customer asks about delivery dates and implementation

questions.text: Which details should a follow-up email after a customer meeting include? Select all that apply.
options: A summary of what was discussed
Agreed next steps with owners and dates
Any open questions to be answered
correct: A summary of what was discussed
Agreed next steps with owners and dates
Any open questions to be answered

questions.text: What is 'account mapping'?
options: Drawing the customer's office floor plan
Identifying the people, roles, and influence inside a customer organisation
Listing all invoices for an account
correct: Identifying the people, roles, and influence inside a customer organisation

questions.text: A forecast should be based on the stage and evidence of each deal, not only on the salesperson's optimism.
correct: True

questions.text: Pricing, discount limits, and approval levels for 3C IT Solutions are found in which source?
options: [PLACEHOLDER: company pricing and discount policy, to be supplied by the company]
correct: [PLACEHOLDER: company pricing and discount policy, to be supplied by the company]

questions.text: What is the main benefit of solution-based selling over product-based selling?
options: It always produces a lower price
It ties the offer to the customer's business problem and outcome
It avoids talking to technical teams
correct: It ties the offer to the customer's business problem and outcome
